messages.subject: SABIC | International Director | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear SABIC Recruitment Team,

I am introducing my candidacy for senior leadership opportunities in Saudi Arabia where industrial growth, sustainability, government relations and stakeholder confidence intersect. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, compliance coordination and executive communications across a complex mining operation.

SABIC’s scale and strategic role in the Kingdom make this a particularly strong fit. My value lies in translating external expectations into disciplined internal ownership across regulators, communities, technical teams and executives, including work connected to renewable energy, carbon-data governance and responsible industrial development.

I would welcome consideration for Director, Senior Director, Head or VP-track mandates across ESG, sustainability, external affairs, government relations, strategic partnerships, responsible business or country-facing leadership. I am internationally mobile, available following a 30-day notice period, and require employer-supported work authorization.

My three-page executive CV is attached for confidential review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth “Randy” Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop/
